name: documentation-quality-gates
title: Add documentation quality gates
description: Add one deterministic read-only local and CI entrypoint for recursive Markdown, tracked relative links, Trellis state, current release notes, AI evidence, and active PRD placeholder contracts.
creator: TalexDreamSoul
notes: Batch D is a stacked integration gate after A, B, C, and the bilingual What's Changed contract. It reads prerequisite documentation but does not rewrite prose, including README.md or README.zh-CN.md, to make the gate pass.

meta.nextAction: After all four prerequisite documentation contracts are available, create the stacked integration branch and record their exact PR URLs and commits before implementing the verifier.
meta.blocker: The docs-sot, roadmap/release, peripheral-docs, and concurrent bilingual What's Changed PRs must all be available on the integration branch.
meta.evidence: prd.md acceptance criteria, deterministic fixture results, repeated read-only repository runs, CI parity, and the final prerequisite/owned-path diff.
